subject: [AMBER] installing Amber24 for non-commerical use and AmberTools24

messages.author: Andriy Kovalenko
messages.body:
Hello,
I am trying to install Amber24 for non-commerical use and AmberTools24 on
my Ubuntu desktop.
However, the download from
https://ambermd.org/GetAmber.php
does not
contain the folder amber24_src/build with its contents, which is required
to begin the installation.
Please advise.
Thank you,
